The activity comprised 4 online transaction(s) under product code(s) C, in billing region 123, 225, 420. Online transactions came from device profile(s) Trident/7.0 | Windows 10 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080; Windows | Windows 10 | edge 16.0 | 3440x1440; Windows | Windows 10 | chrome 63.0 | UNK. The purchases were placed within minutes of each other, each just below a $500 threshold, a pattern that avoids single-transaction limits. When contacted: Customer states they did not make the $475.22 transaction and still has the card (simulated). The same burst shape was found on 6 cards of 6 different customers in the preceding 30 days, indicating coordinated abuse (policy R9). The amount exceeds the $1,000 reporting threshold. Total suspicious amount: $1,906.11. Actions recommended: BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST.
